s: Historically unprotected categories are "well-defined and narrowly limited" (Chaplinsky v. New Hampshire, 1942).
Courts may not create new ones by balancing (Stevens; Brown v. Entertainment Merchants, 2011, violent video games; United States v. Alvarez, 2012, lies about military medals).
Even within a category, viewpoint discrimination is forbidden (R.A.V. v. St. Paul, 1992).
